Message Intent: Acknowledgement  of  receipt  of  a  CPDLC  downlink MAYDAY message.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Acknowledgement  of  receipt  of  a  CPDLC  downlinked PAN message.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification that an ADS-C emergency report  has been received from the aircraft.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.

Notification  that  the  CPDLC  downlink  request was:  1) part of the approved message set; and  2) received by the controller.  The  aircraft  will  receive  any  further  communication  about  the  request  via  voice  contact with the specified unit.  [unit_description]  is  the  name  of  the  radio  facility  with  which  the  response  will  be  communicated.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: REQUEST  RECEIVED  RESPONSE  WILL  BE  VIA  [unit_description]

Message Intent: Indication that the request has been received  and has been forwarded on to the next ATSU. Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  211.
Indicates  that  the  request  cannot  be  responded  to  by  the  current  unit  and  that  it  should be requested from the next unit.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  237.
Used  with  a  vertical  clearance,  indicating  an  ITP  clearance  when  there  is  one  reference  aircraft ahead.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Used  with  a  vertical  clearance,  indicating  an  ITP  clearance  when  there  is  one  reference  aircraft behind.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Used  with  a  vertical  clearance,  indicating  an  ITP  clearance  when  there  are  two  reference  aircraft, both ahead.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ITP  BEHIND[aircraft  identification]  AND  BEHIND  [aircraft  identification]

Message Intent: Used  with  a  vertical  clearance,  indicating  an  ITP  clearance  when  there  are  two  reference  aircraft, both behind:  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ITP  AHEAD  OF  [aircraft  identification] AND AHEAD  OF [aircraft identification]

Message Intent: Used  with  a  vertical  clearance,  indicating  an  ITP  clearance  when  there  are  two  reference  aircraft, one ahead and the other behind.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ITP  BEHIND  [aircraft  identification] AND AHEAD  OF [aircraft identification]

Message Intent: Notification  that  a  previously  issued  speed  can  be  expected  to  be  maintained  until  the  specified position or time.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification  that  the  aircraft  may  keep  its  preferred speed without restriction.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  222.
Instruction  that  the  “ident”  function  of  the  ADS-B emitter is to be activated.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  242.
Instruction  to  report  the  ground  speed  of  the  aircraft.  Note.— Intent similar partially to ICAO Doc  4444 UM 134.
Instruction to advise the preferred flight level  for the flight.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  231
Instruction  to  report  the  estimated  time  of  arrival at the specified position.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  228.
Instruction  to  notify  when  the  specified  traffic has been observed by visual contact to  have passed.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: REPORT  SIGHTING  AND  PASSING  OPPOSITE  DIRECTION  [traffic  description] ETP [time]

Message Intent: Instruction to notify of receipt of any ADS-C  report  indicating  a  deviation  from  cleared  route and to request the flight crew to advise  of intentions.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ADS-C  INDICATES  OFF  ROUTE.  ADVISE  INTENTIONS.

Message Intent: Instruction to notify of receipt of any ADS-C  report  indicating  a  deviation  from  cleared  level and to request the flight crew to advise  of intentions.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ADS-C INDICATES LEVEL  DEVIATION.    ADVISE  INTENTIONS.

Message Intent: Instruction to notify of receipt of any ADS-C  report  indicating  a  deviation  from  cleared  speed and to request the flight crew to advise  of intentions.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ADS-C INDICATES SPEED  DEVIATION.    ADVISE  INTENTIONS.

Message Intent: Instruction to notify of receipt of any ADS-C  report that appears to contain inaccurate time  estimates  and  to  request  the  flight  crew  to  check FMS.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ADS-C  ESTIMATES  APPEAR  INACCURATE.   CHECK FMS.

Message Intent: Instruction  to  indicate  the  preferred  time  to  commence  descent  to  the  aerodrome  of  intended arrival.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  232 for time only.
Notification  that  a  SELCAL  check  on  the  specified HF frequency should be expected.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.

Notification that the CPDLC transfer process  will  not  be  completed  at  the  boundary  and  will  be  delayed  until  the  specified  time  or  position.  If  the  CPDLC  transfer  is  not  completed  by  the  specified  time  or  position,  the  flight  crew  should  manually  disconnect  CPDLC  and  initiate  a  logon  to  the  next  center.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
ATS  advisory  that  the  radar  and/or  ADS-B  service is terminated.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  244.

Notification that a CPDLC connection is not  required by the next ATSU (e.g. due to short  transition  time  through  the  next  ATSU’s  airspace)  and  CPDLC  connection  will  be  transferred to the subsequent ATSU.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: EXPECT  NEXT  CENTER  [facility  designation].  CONTACT  WITH  [facility  designation]  NOT  REQUIRED

Message Intent: Notification of traffic significant to the flight. Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification  of  the  secondary  frequency  for  the area.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  238.
ATS  advisory  that  normal  voice  communication is not available.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: TRY  SATCOM  VOICE  OR  RELAY  THROUGH  ANOTHER AIRCRAFT

Message Intent: ATS  advisory  that  the  specified  altimeter  setting relates to the specified facility.  Note.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 UM  213.
Used  after  ATC  cannot  comply  with  an  ITP  request to advise of intermediate flight levels  that are available for an ITP.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: SEND  NEW  ITP  REQUEST  IF ABLE [level]

Message Intent: Instruction  to  check  the  status  of  CPDLC  messages  and  to  respond  to  unanswered  uplink messages.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: CHECK  AND  RESPOND  TO  OPEN  CPDLC  MESSAGES

Message Intent: Instruction  to  set  the  message  latency  monitor to the specified value.  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: SET MAX UPLINK DELAY  VALUE  TO  [delayed  message  parameter]  SECONDS

Message Intent: Instruction to check that the message latency  monitor function is off.  Note 1.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: CONFIRM  MAX  UPLINK  DELAY  VALUE  IS  NOT  SET

Message Intent: Notification  that  an  element  contained  in  a  CPDLC  downlink  message  was  not  part  of  the approved CPDLC message set.  Note.—  Equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  UM  162.
Message Element: MESSAGE  NOT  SUPPORTED  BY  THIS  ATS UNIT

Message Intent: Notification  that  an  element  contained  in  a  CPDLC  downlink  message  was  not  part  of  the  approved  message  set.    The  message  should  be  communicated  by  voice  (i.e.  radiotelephone (RTF)).  Note.— No equivalent to ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: MESSAGE  NOT  SUPPORTED  BY  THIS  ATS UNIT, CONTACT RTF

Message Intent: Instruction to turn the CPDLC application off  and to initiate a logon to the specified ATSU.
Message Element: AUTOMATIC  TRANSFER  OF  CPDLC  FAILED.  WHEN  ENTERING  [unit  name]  AREA  DISCONNECT  CPDLC  THEN  LOGON  TO  [facility  designation]

Message Intent: Instruction  for  the  flight  crew  to  check  that  the ADS-C function is armed.
Instruction  to  transmit  CPDLC  position  reports due to the failure of ADS-C.
Message Element: ADS-C  SHUT  DOWN  AT  [facility  designation].  REVERT  TO  CPDLC  POSITION  REPORTS.   LEAVE ADS-C ARMED.

Message Intent: Instruction  to  transmit  voice  position  reports  due to the failure of ADS-C.
Message Element: ADS-C  SHUT  DOWN  AT  [facility  designation].   REVERT  TO  VOICE  POSITION  REPORTS.   LEAVE ADS-C ARMED.

Message Intent: Instruction  to  advise  that  CPDLC  and  voice  position  reports  are  not  required  due  to  ADS-C resuming operations.
Message Element: RESUME NORMAL ADS-C  OPERATIONS.  CPDLC  AND  VOICE  POSITION  REPORTS  NOT  REQUIRED

Message Intent: Instruction  to  continue  on  voice  due  to  the  failure of CPDLC.
Message Element: CPDLC  WILL  BE  SHUT  DOWN.  DISCONNECT  CPDLC.  CONTINUE  ON  VOICE

Message Intent: Instruction  for  intermediary  CPDLC-capable  aircraft  to  relay  message  to  aircraft  not  in  communication with ATC.
Message Element: RELAY  TO  [call  sign]  [unit  name] [text of message to be  relayed]

Message Intent: Notification  that  MARSA  procedures  with  the specified aircraft have been terminated.
Message Element: MARSA  TERMINATED  WITH  [call  sign(s)  of  receiver aircraft]
CLEARED  TO  DELAY  FOR  AIR  REFUEL  AT  [position] UNTIL [time]

Message Intent: Request  for  a  tailored  arrival.    The  TA  designator and speed are optional.  Note 1.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.  Note  2.—  When  pre-formatting  of  the  downlink  message  is  not  available,  the  flight  crew  can  shorten  to: REQ TA [TA designator]
Message Element: REQUEST  TAILORED  ARRIVAL  [TA  designator]  [speed]  or  REQ  TA  [TA  designator] [speed]

Message Intent: Used with a vertical request, indicating an ITP  request  when  there  is  one  reference  aircraft  ahead.  Note 1.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Used with a vertical request, indicating an ITP  request  when  there  is  one  reference  aircraft  behind.  Note 1.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Used with a vertical request, indicating an ITP  request  when  there  are  two  reference  aircraft,  both ahead.  Note 1.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ITP [distance] BEHIND[aircraft  identification]  AND  [distance]  BEHIND  [aircraft  identification]

Message Intent: Used with a vertical request, indicating an ITP  request  when  there  are  two  reference  aircraft,  both behind.  Note 1.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ITP  [distance]  AHEAD  OF  [aircraft  identification]  AND  [distance] AHEAD OF [aircraft  identification]

Message Intent: Used with a vertical request, indicating an ITP  request  when  there  are  two  reference  aircraft,  one ahead and the other behind.  Note 1.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ITP  [distance]  BEHIND  [aircraft  identification]  AND  [distance] AHEAD OF [aircraft  identification]

Message Intent: Notification  of  a  revised  estimate  for  the  specified position.  Note.— Intent similar to DM 43.

Notification of the ground speed.  Note  1.—  Intent  partial  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 113.  Note  2.—  When  pre-formatting  of  the  downlink  message  is  not  available,  the  flight  crew  can  shorten  to: GS [speed]

Notification of the preferred level.  Note 1.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 DM  106.  Note  2.—  When  pre-formatting  of  the  downlink  message  is  not  available,  the  flight  crew  can  shorten  to: FL[altitude]

Notification of estimated time of arrival at the  specified position.  Note 1.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 DM  104.  Note  2.—  When  pre-formatting  of  the  downlink  message  is  not  available,  the  flight  crew  can  shorten  to: [position] [time]
Notification  that  the  flight  crew  has  visually  sighted and passed the specified traffic.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification  that  the  flight  crew  did  NOT  visually sight the specified traffic.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification  that  the  previously  described  traffic has been sighted.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.

Notification  of  the  preferred  time  to  commence descent for an approach.  Note 1.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 DM  109.  Note  2.—  When  pre-formatting  of  the  downlink  message  is  not  available,  the  flight  crew  can  shorten  to: TOD [time]

The  specified  ATSU  is  being  monitored  on  the specified frequency.  Urgent urgency attribute.  Note  1.—  Airborne  automation  (i.e.  preformatted  message  rather  than  the  flight  crew  typing  the  text)  may  be  necessary  for  message  composition  and  to  ensure  accuracy  of the message content.  Consequently, not all  aircraft  will  be  equipped  with  such  automation.  Note 2.— Same intent as ICAO Doc 4444 DM  89.

Notification that the delivery time of an uplink  message exceeded the maximum permitted by  the latency timer.  The uplink message should  be re-sent or communicated by other means.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: UPLINK  DELAYED  IN  NETWORK  AND  REJECTED  - RESEND OR CONTACT BY  VOICE

Message Intent: Notification  that  the  transfer  of  the  CPDLC  connection has failed.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification that the ADS-C emergency mode  was inadvertent and has been set to OFF.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification  from  the  intermediary  CPDLC- capable  aircraft  that  the  aircraft  not  in  communication received the instructions.

Notification that the aircraft does not have the  functionality of a message latency monitor.  Note 1.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.  Note  2.—  Response  to  free  text  UM  169au  CONFIRM MAX UPLINK DELAY VALUE IS  NOT  SET  or  UM  169w  SET  MAX  UPLINK  DELAY  VALUE  TO  [delayed  message  parameter] SECONDS.
Used  with  DM  27,  indicating  a  request  for  a  weather deviation on both sides of route.
We  can  accept  the  specified  level  at  the  specified time.  Note.—  Intent  equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 81.
We  can  accept  the  specified  speed  at  the  specified time.  Note.—  Intent  equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 83.
We  can  accept  a  parallel  track  offset  the  specified distance in the specified direction at  the specified time.  Note.—  Intent  equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 85.
We cannot accept the specified level.  Note.—  Intent  equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 82.
We cannot accept the specified speed.  Note.—  Intent  equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 84.
We  cannot  accept  a  parallel  track  offset  the  specified distance in the specified direction.  Note.—  Intent  equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 86.
Request  for  the  earliest  time  at  which  a  clearance to climb to the specified level can be  expected.  Note.—  Intent  equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 87.
Message Element: WHEN  CAN  WE  EXPECT  CLIMB TO [altitude]

Message Intent: Request  for  the  earliest  time  at  which  a  clearance to descend to the specified level can  be expected.  Note.—  Intent  equivalent  to  ICAO  Doc  4444  DM 88.
Message Element: WHEN  CAN  WE  EXPECT  DESCENT TO [altitude]

Message Intent: Request  for  a  delay  at  the  specified  position  until  a  specified  time  to  rendezvous  with  the  receiver aircraft.  Note  1.—  [position]  is  the  ARCP  as  filed  in  the tanker’s flight plan.  [time] is the time the  tanker  expects  to  pass  the  ARCP  and  commence refueling along the refueling route.   It is also the end of the delay time.  Note 2.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: TO  DELAY  FOR  AIR  REFUEL AT [position] UNTIL  [time]

Message Intent: Notification  that  refueling  will  end  at  the  specified time or position.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification  that  the  aircraft  will  be  joining  the specified ALTRV at the specified position  or time.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Notification  that  the  tanker  will  accept  MARSA with the specified (receiver) aircraft.  Note.— No equivalent in ICAO Doc 4444.
Message Element: ACCEPT  MARSA  WITH  [call  sign(s) of receiver aircraft]
